applicant_profile.purchaser_type: Credit union, mortgage company, or finance company

scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and wanted to check on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. You were approved for a conventional subordinate lien loan.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me the interest rate and total costs associated with this loan? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 8.1%. The loan record does not include total costs. This loan is not flagged as a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you also let me know if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company. Your debt-to-income ratio is between 20% and 30%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts, and it can affect your loan eligibility and terms.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have a few more questions. What is the status of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending? Also, what is the loan term for my approved loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved. The loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me the reason for any denial or unfavorable terms? Also, what is my loan amount?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was not denied, so there are no denial reasons. The loan amount is $125,000.

dialogue.user: Got it. Can you confirm if my loan was approved for a home purchase or a home improvement? Also, was a preapproval requested for this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was approved for home improvement. A preapproval was not requested for this loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I believe that covers everything I needed to know. <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction because the agent provided clear and accurate information about my loan status, terms, and other details. The agent was polite, professional, and responsive to my questions.
